title: Staff, Technical Support Engineer
description_text:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work :

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer

About the job

This position is needed to support our customers’ use of the Twilio platform, and help customers get the best experience from Twilio’s products. You will function as the voice of Twilio to our customers and partners, and operate as a subject matter expert for Twilio’s APIs and SDKs.

We are looking for our next Staff, Technical Support Engineer to join our global Voice Segment Platform Applications (VSPA) team, who will be dedicated to resolving highly complex customer requests, managing critical escalations, and driving technical process improvements. You will mentor peers and collaborate cross-functionally. Critically, you will leverage advanced troubleshooting expertise—including programming languages, SQL, REST APIs, DevTools, network connectivity (PCAP), and data analytics—to resolve deep technical issues and ensure customer success.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Address and deconstruct highly sophisticated customer inquiries across various live and digital support channels. Distill intricate technical concepts into clear communications, balancing professional empathy with the necessary sense of urgency.
  • Proactively identify potential customer friction points to mitigate escalations before they arise. Take decisive action to resolve critical issues rapidly while remaining strictly within established SLA parameters.
  • Maintain meticulous records of every interaction, ensuring technical artifacts—such as Splunk queries, JIRA tickets, and logs—are thoroughly captured. Demonstrate a commitment to “writing it down” by updating team knowledge bases and internal troubleshooting guides throughout the case lifecycle.
  • Harness the power of Twilio’s AI suites and internal automation tools to streamline customer workflows and enhance communication efficiency.
  • Empower others through mentorship on case management excellence. Actively contribute to the growth of the team by leading the onboarding of new Twilions and designing structured technical training modules.
  • Collaborate and network across functional silos, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Sales—as well as external partner organizations—to architect the solutions our customers require.
  • Diagnose systemic operational hurdles and champion innovative process improvements. Exhibit a “Drawing the Owl” mindset by leading technical projects that allow the support organization to operate at a global scale.

Qualifications 

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience with API or enterprise software, including technical troubleshooting experience.
  • Intermediate proficiency in programming languages (such as C#, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Python, or React.js) and REST APIs, including basic experience using REST API tools like Postman.
  • Good knowledge of SQL and Data Analysis using analytics tools (such as Looker, Tableau, CloudZero Dashboard, etc.).
  • Strong networking connectivity knowledge and PCAP analysis, including skills in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS
  • Fluency in English (verbal, comprehension, listening, and writing) with high competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone, chat, or email.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills, combined with advanced case management, excellent time management, and the ability to de-escalate difficult or complex customer situations in a live environment
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting issues using DevTools and a core understanding of SSO/Auth0.
  • Understanding of Cloud Technologies (AWS, GCP & Azure) and Serverless platforms (Lambda).
  • Availability to work on weekends or holidays as needed.

Desired:

  • Segment Product Knowledge.
  • Creative problem-solving skills, teamwork abilities to influence all levels of the organization, and utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
  • Familiarity with Log Analysis for Web applications using tools like Kibana or Grafana.
  • Familiarity with Application Monitoring (APM) Tools and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML, including query search and AI/LLMs

Location:

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

What We Offer

There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
